sources.rules: Existing original card powers checked against supplied Expanded CRD; no named overrides for cards 1-10.
sources.wording_policy: Apply current Expanded CRD corrections first, then modernize per references/card-wording.md. Put applicable Banish after use in the leading power block. Use generic attack type and immediate cost, DAMAGE with AT and explicit units; HIT only for success-dependent effects. Preserve mechanics and omit inherent copy limits.
sources.artwork: Cards 1 and 6: approved cleaned previews. Cards 2-5: retained native artwork. Cards 7-10: retained published artwork, downloaded from Kaoxt/dragonball. No repainting.
